title: enable-apt-and-yum-mirror-indexing-and-offline-chart-manifests
author: Aisha Patel
description: This PR adds first-class support for mirroring Debian (apt) and RHEL/CentOS-style (yum/dnf) package repositories as part of the air-gapped installer bundles and introduces an image-manifest indexing step that powers the offline Helm chart index and the installer preflight verification. Motivation: customers in regulated environments commonly request reproducible on-prem bundles where OS/package artifacts are mirrored alongside container images; previously we only produced OCI tarballs and a simple image list which was error-prone for apt/yum pipelines. Changes: 1) new mirror tooling under install/packaging that builds a minimal apt repo (Packages.gz + Release + GPG signing hooks) and a yum repo layout with repomd.xml generation; 2) an image-manifest/index generator that emits a single index JSON connecting package artifacts, image tarballs, and Helm chart archives; 3) offline Helm chart modifications to read the generated index and resolve image references using mirror prefixes; 4) Terraform module inputs to configure mirror prefixes, preseed signing keys, and S3/HTTP storage backends for bundle hosting; 5) a new upgrade/rollback helper script (scripts/upgrade/rollback-airgap.sh) that validates the index, verifies checksums/signatures, and supports staged rollbacks by restoring prior index snapshots; 6) docs for maintainers and a new integration smoke test for mirrored bundles. Implementation notes: the apt/yum mirroring code is intentionally lightweight (no external apt-mirror deps) and designed to run inside our airgap-bundler container; we generate deterministic manifests with content-addressed filenames to make delta uploads easier; GPG signing is optional and controlled via terraform variable mirror_signing_key; Helm offline chart support uses a small pre-render hook to rewrite image refs at install-time when a mirror prefix is provided. Backward compatibility and upgrades: index format is versioned (index_version: "v1"); the installer supports legacy bundles by falling back to legacy-image-list.json when index v1 is absent; upgrade script migrates existing bundle layout to the new index and snapshots previous layout for rollback. Testing and validation: added unit tests for index generation, integration test that builds a tiny apt repo and validates apt-get update inside a container, and a CI job that runs a full bundle build on a smaller sample to exercise Terraform variables. Security: keys are never baked into bundles; the default flow uses a separate key export step and the installer reads from a provided key file during signing. Linear tickets and risk: ties to ENG-2248 for index spec and INF-331 for terraform inputs. This is scoped to the private-installer repo and should not affect hosted runtime. Merge notes: squash-merged; follow-up tasks include adding SUSE/zypper support in a subsequent PR and upstreaming the index schema to the model-registry for cross-product compatibility.

review_conversation: Ethan Nguyen (reviewer): Please split the index schema validation into a dedicated test file; it's hard to follow in index_generator_test.go. Also can we avoid invoking gpg by default in CI? Suggested making it opt-in.
Aisha Patel (author): Split validation tests into index_schema_test.go and added a CI flag `AIRGAP_SIGNING=false` to skip GPG in CI. Updated tests accordingly.
Riley Chen (reviewer): Terraform inputs look good but we should provide a deprecation plan for mirror_prefix legacy variable; please add a migration snippet.
Aisha Patel (author): Added migration notes in terraform/README.md and left mirror_prefix as an alias for the new mirror_prefixes map to preserve behavior.
Sofia Martinez (approver): Verified the integration smoke test passes locally with k3s in containerd mode. Approved pending CI green and a brief note about operations runbook.
CI Bot: integration-airgap flaky on first run due to network timeouts when pulling sample packages; re-run triggered by @AishaPatel; subsequent run passed.
Merge summary: PR squash-merged by Riley Chen after approvals and green CI.
release_notes: Private installer: Add apt/yum mirror generation and image-manifest index (index v1); Offline Helm charts can now resolve mirrored images via mirror_prefixes; Terraform module gains mirror_prefixes, mirror_signing_key and storage_backend inputs; new upgrade/rollback helper for airgap bundles; docs added for maintainers.
notes: Follow-up: add SUSE/zypper support and broaden bundle signing CI coverage.
Operator runbook: docs/airgap-maintainers.md includes verify-index and rollback steps; ensure mirror signing key is supplied via secure channel.
Compatibility: bundles without index_v1 will still be accepted via legacy fallback; recommend regenerating bundles to adopt index v1 before major upgrades.
